description: This Java class 'MessageOnlyLogFilter' implements the 'LogNode' interface, providing a filter that outputs only the log message, omitting metadata. It is used to streamline log output for readability, especially in on-screen logs.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter for log messages that outputs only the log message itself, omitting metadata like tags or priorities.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an optional next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message by passing only the message itself to the next LogNode if available, with a priority of Log.NONE.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
